comments: Longer-schedule version of kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_finetune.json (0.3684 val dice, peaked epoch 216/300 then overfit): nb_epochs/Tmax both doubled to 600 so the cosine LR decay stretches proportionally over twice as many epochs, rather than just running more epochs on the same 300-epoch schedule (which would let CosineAnnealingLR cycle back up past its T_max minimum -- not a clean test). Same architecture/init/lr/no extra augmentation (hflip/vflip only) otherwise, so schedule length is the isolated variable. Tests whether a more gradual anneal reaches a better peak than the original 300-epoch run, or whether epoch 216's plateau reflects a real ceiling regardless of schedule length.
